units.source_text: 古歌：“昔年依慈母，曾闻戒昼寝。

en.t: An old poem says: Long ago, beside my loving mother, I once heard her warning against daytime sleep.

units.source_text: 但逢愁闷时，瞌睡苦难禁。”

en.t: Yet when sorrow and distress come over me, it is painfully hard to keep drowsiness away.
It appears in the Shūi Wakashū.

units.source_text: 此处引此古歌，暗示她忘记了八亲王的遗诫而结婚。

en.t: Quoting this old poem here hints that she forgot the Eighth Prince's dying admonition and married.
